podcast.title: Depeche Mode Comparison
podcast.body: Upon its release, "The Great Commandment" was initially thought by some to be a new Depeche Mode song due to its similar sound. "I remember when this song arrived at the radio station and at first listen, we thought it was a brand new Dopech mode song."

podcast.title: Featured in Puzzle Sessions (1980s)
podcast.body: Camouflage was one of the bands frequently played in Puzzle's sessions during the 1980s. Puzzle embraced a more refined and varied musical palette, introducing genres such as synth pop, techno pop, and house, making it a distinct venue within the Ruta for its brighter sound. "Durante los 80, en sus sesiones se podían escuchar bandas como New Order o Camo Flash."

podcast.title: German Success
podcast.body: The band remains very popular in Germany, where most of their eight albums have charted well, in contrast to their limited success elsewhere. "I will concede that they remain a big deal in Germany with eight albums, most of which have reached the upper half of the German charts."

podcast.title: Groups with Technopop DNA
podcast.body: Camouflage was identified as one of the groups that retained strong Technopop DNA in their music, indicating the lasting influence of the genre even as its pure form declined through the late 1980s. "And there were other groups with plenty of Technopop DNA, camouflage, went in Rome, the information society, Khan Khan."

podcast.title: Origin
podcast.body: Camouflage originated in West Germany in 1983, emerging as part of the Technopop scene. "They came from West Germany in 1983 and were part of the whole Technopop thing back then."

xref.title: Singer's Solo Career
xref.body: After his time with Wall of Voodoo, singer Stan Ridgway embarked on a solo career, achieving a few minor alt-rock hits. These included "Drive, She Said," "Go On Southbound," "The Big Heat," "I Want to Be a Boss," and "Camouflage." "Singer-Stand Ridgeway would later go solo and have a couple of minor alt-rock hits of his own, including drive, she said, go on Southbound, the big heats, I want to be a boss and camouflage."
